scientific_interpretation: Role-reversal Arm B again shows non-monotonic review quality. Later review repaired structured scope errors and ultimately recovered the protected fixture-state diagnosis for EXP-C-001, but the final reviewer simultaneously introduced a new primary-versus-contributor error on EXP-C-006.
